# FG-DB-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`append-only-violation`](../../ops/runbooks/append-only-violation.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_event_without_an_audit_row_cannot_commit` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 変更の記録に失敗したため、変更を取り消しました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The change was undone because it could not be recorded. Contact the administrator.
- id: Perubahan dibatalkan karena tidak dapat dicatat. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

A transaction tried to commit a domain event (forge.events) without an audit row (forge.audit_log) in the same transaction, and the deferred constraint trigger refused the commit (SQLSTATE XF002, ADR-0016 §1). Every state change goes through forge-db's ChangeTx, which writes both; reaching this means a write bypassed ChangeTx (a bug or a manual change). Until step C5 (DerivedTx) this applies to derived events (caused_by_seq set) too.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event carries `query` (the statement that committed, or the insert when the transaction ran SET CONSTRAINTS IMMEDIATE), `reason=no_audit_row`, `sqlstate=XF002` and `db_message`. Find the writer: the root gate db-write-boundary forbids writes outside forge-db; inside forge-db every insert into forge.events must come from ChangeTx::commit. forge_audit.ddl_audit shows whether the trigger was changed recently.

## 対処 (fix)

Route the write through ChangeTx (forge-db typed command). Never disable the trigger; the change was rolled back and can be retried once fixed.
